svg.title: Day 3 hero: a student stands at a lectern and points to a large screen showing the slide “Impacts of Digital Devices”, where a bar chart grows and a line draws itself, with Positive and Negative points. Classmates seen from behind ask “What do you mean by ‘people’?” and “Why is that important?”. A 2:00 stopwatch ticks at the top left, a peer feedback clipboard is being ticked at the right, and a SMART plan card floats at the bottom left.
